items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Paul Crawford is made by the Interviewer, and the Interviewee does not respond or confirm any personal connection.

ctx.x: Yeah, at Ken Artin. Well he plays fine violin, he's a good all around violin player, Ken. How often do they work there? I think it's been cut down to one night now. They won't work in two nights but I think they cut down to one night. But Ken plays a good all around violin. He's one of the best violin player in town for all around work. He can play a little jazz too, but he knows a lot of tunes and plays good straight violin tunes.
That accordion player that plays with Paul Crawford, you know how you call it, he plays that? Oh yeah, Matt. He plays that too?
He used to. Oh yeah, I didn't know that.
